name: Aircraft
summary: Unit-type keyword. Aircraft deploy to and must return to strategic reserves each turn, can only arrive by an ingress move, cannot declare charges, and can only be charged or fought by units that can Fly.

name: Anti-Chaos X+
summary: Weapon ability written Anti-Chaos X+. While the target unit carries the CHAOS keyword, an unmodified wound roll of X or more counts as a critical wound. Each weapon prints its own X.

name: Anti-Character X+
summary: Weapon ability written Anti-Character X+. While the target unit carries the CHARACTER keyword, an unmodified wound roll of X or more counts as a critical wound. Each weapon prints its own X.

name: Anti-Daemon X+
summary: Weapon ability written Anti-Daemon X+. While the target unit carries the DAEMON keyword, an unmodified wound roll of X or more counts as a critical wound. Each weapon prints its own X.

name: Anti-Epic Hero X+
summary: Weapon ability written Anti-Epic Hero X+. While the target unit carries the EPIC HERO keyword, an unmodified wound roll of X or more counts as a critical wound. Each weapon prints its own X.

name: Anti-Fly X+
summary: Weapon ability written Anti-Fly X+. While the target unit carries the FLY keyword, an unmodified wound roll of X or more counts as a critical wound. Each weapon prints its own X.

name: Anti-Infantry X+
summary: Weapon ability written Anti-Infantry X+. While the target unit carries the INFANTRY keyword, an unmodified wound roll of X or more counts as a critical wound. Each weapon prints its own X.

name: Anti-Monster X+
summary: Weapon ability written Anti-Monster X+. While the target unit carries the MONSTER keyword, an unmodified wound roll of X or more counts as a critical wound. Each weapon prints its own X.

name: Anti-Psyker X+
summary: Weapon ability written Anti-Psyker X+. While the target unit carries the PSYKER keyword, an unmodified wound roll of X or more counts as a critical wound. Each weapon prints its own X.

name: Anti-Titanic X+
summary: Weapon ability written Anti-Titanic X+. While the target unit carries the TITANIC keyword, an unmodified wound roll of X or more counts as a critical wound. Each weapon prints its own X.

name: Anti-Tyranids X+
summary: Weapon ability written Anti-Tyranids X+. While the target unit carries the TYRANIDS keyword, an unmodified wound roll of X or more counts as a critical wound. Each weapon prints its own X.

name: Anti-Vehicle X+
summary: Weapon ability written Anti-Vehicle X+. While the target unit carries the VEHICLE keyword, an unmodified wound roll of X or more counts as a critical wound. Each weapon prints its own X.

name: Anti-Walker X+
summary: Weapon ability written Anti-Walker X+. While the target unit carries the WALKER keyword, an unmodified wound roll of X or more counts as a critical wound. Each weapon prints its own X.

name: Assault
summary: Weapon ability. A unit holding one or more of these may shoot after advancing, using the assault shooting mode - in which only assault weapons may be fired and the unit cannot begin an action afterwards.

name: Battleline
summary: Force-organisation keyword. An army's per-datasheet unit limit is doubled for units with this keyword, letting more of them be fielded than other unit types at a given battle size.

name: Beast
summary: Unit-type keyword, the singular of Beasts. Its models move through dense terrain, get benefit of cover inside a terrain area, and are hidden in one holding dense terrain if their unit made no ranged attacks this turn or last turn.

name: Beasts
summary: Unit-type keyword. Beasts models move through dense terrain, get benefit of cover inside a terrain area, and are hidden in a terrain area holding dense terrain if their unit made no ranged attacks this turn or last turn.

name: Blast
summary: Weapon ability. Gather one extra attack die for every five models the target unit contained when targets were chosen, rounding down.

name: Bubblechukka
summary: Weapon ability for a weapon with several random profiles. Before targets are chosen for the models carrying it, roll one D6 and use the profile the datasheet pairs with that result.

name: C'tan Power
summary: Weapon marker. A weapon carrying it cannot simply be fired: the bearer's own datasheet ability picks a limited number of these weapons each Shooting phase, and only the picked ones may attack that phase.

name: Character
summary: Unit-type keyword. Your Warlord is one Character model in a Character unit that has your army faction keyword. Unless a rule says otherwise, only Character units may be given an enhancement, and each enhancement goes to a different unit.

name: Cleave X
summary: Weapon ability written Cleave X. If every one of the weapon's attacks is aimed at a single target, gather X extra attack dice for every five models that unit held when targets were chosen, rounding down.

name: Close-Quarters
summary: Weapon ability. Its unit may use close-quarters shooting while engaged, targeting units it is engaged with. Under any other shooting mode a model that is not a Monster or Vehicle fires either these or its other ranged weapons.

name: Conversion
summary: Weapon ability rewarding distance. Beyond the range its datasheet prints, an unmodified successful hit roll of 4 or more counts as a critical hit. The distance varies by weapon.

name: Dead Choppy
summary: Weapon ability. The weapon's Attacks characteristic rises by 1 for each further copy of the same weapon the bearer is equipped with.

name: Dedicated Transport
summary: Unit-type keyword. Each Dedicated Transport must have a unit embarked by the end of Declare Battle Formations or it is destroyed, without triggering on-destroyed rules. It shares the doubled per-datasheet limit Battleline units have.

name: Devastating Wounds
summary: Weapon ability. A critical wound ends that attack's sequence and inflicts mortal wounds equal to the weapon's Damage, applied after normal damage. At most one model may be destroyed per critical wound; the remainder is lost.

name: Devastating Wounds: Monster/Vehicle
summary: Target-restricted form of Devastating Wounds. The ability applies only while the target unit carries the MONSTER or VEHICLE keyword; against any other target the weapon resolves with no such effect.

name: Epic Hero
summary: Datasheet-role keyword. A model with this keyword cannot be given an Enhancement, and an army is limited to one unit bearing this keyword per datasheet, regardless of battle size.

name: Extra Attacks
summary: Weapon ability. Its attacks are made on top of the model's other melee attacks, and a model may attack with its extra-attacks weapons without also selecting any melee weapon that lacks the ability.

name: Fly
summary: Movement keyword. A unit can take to the skies: its maximum move distance is reduced by 2", but it then ignores vertical distance and can move through any model and any terrain feature.

name: Fortification
summary: Unit-type keyword. Fortification units cannot start actions, and are excluded when friendly units are placed into strategic reserves before the battle begins.

name: Grenades
summary: Unit keyword. Makes its unit eligible for the Explosives core stratagem: an unengaged unit that can shoot and did not advance picks an unengaged enemy unit within 8in of and visible to one of its models; roll six D6, 1 mortal wound per 4+.

name: Harpooned
summary: Weapon ability. After the bearer shoots with it, select one enemy Monster or Vehicle unit hit by those attacks; until the end of the turn, add 2 to charge rolls the bearer makes against that unit.

name: Hazardous
summary: Weapon ability. Once its unit has finished attacking, make one hazard roll for each hazardous weapon that attacked, all at once; each roll of 1-2 costs the unit 1 mortal wound, or 3 if every model in it is a Monster or Vehicle.

name: Heavy
summary: Weapon ability. In your own Shooting phase add 1 to its hit rolls, provided the firing unit is unengaged, was not set up this turn, and has no model that moved more than 3 inches this turn.

name: Hooked
summary: Weapon ability. Each time it scores a hit on a Monster or Vehicle unit, until the end of the turn, add 2 to charge rolls the bearer makes against that unit and enemies cannot use the Fire Overwatch stratagem against the bearer.

name: Ignores Cover
summary: Weapon ability. The target cannot have the benefit of cover against its attacks - including benefit granted by a rule rather than by a terrain feature.

name: Impaled
summary: Weapon ability. Each time it scores a hit on an enemy Monster or Vehicle unit, until the end of the turn, add 2 to charge rolls the bearer makes against that unit. It places no restriction on Fire Overwatch.

name: Indirect Fire
summary: Weapon ability. Its unit may use indirect shooting, firing at units it cannot see. Those attacks give the target cover, cannot re-roll hit rolls, and hit only on an unmodified 6 - or a 4+ if the unit stayed still and a friend sees it.

name: Infantry
summary: Unit-type keyword. Infantry models move through dense terrain, get benefit of cover inside a terrain area, and are hidden in a terrain area holding dense terrain if their unit made no ranged attacks this turn or last turn.

name: Lance
summary: Weapon ability. Add 1 to its wound rolls while the attacking model's unit made a charge move in the same turn.

name: Lethal Hits
summary: Weapon ability. On a critical hit you may choose to wound automatically, making no wound roll. Choosing it forgoes any critical wound, so anything that triggers on one does not trigger.

name: Linked Fire
summary: Weapon ability. Range and visibility may be measured from another friendly model of the type the datasheet names that the bearer can see. Firing this way sets the weapon's Attacks characteristic to 1.

name: Melta X
summary: Weapon ability written Melta X. If the target unit was within half the weapon's range when targets were chosen, add X to the weapon's Damage until the attacking unit's attacks are resolved.

name: Monster
summary: Unit-type keyword. In a normal or advance move Monster models move through other models except Monsters and Vehicles, and their unit may use close-quarters shooting. They cross dense terrain only where each section is 2in or less high.

name: One Shot
summary: Weapon ability. The weapon may be selected to attack with only once in the whole battle. A destroyed model returned to its unit does not regain the use of one already fired.

name: Overcharge
summary: Weapon ability. Subtract 2 from the result of every hazard roll the bearer makes for this weapon profile, making its hazardous risk worse.

name: Pistol
summary: Weapon ability, identical to Close-Quarters in every respect. Its unit may use close-quarters shooting while engaged, and under any other shooting mode a model that is not a Monster or Vehicle fires either its pistols or its other guns.

name: Plasma Warhead
summary: Weapon ability. Fired only in your Shooting phase, only after remaining stationary and only if its target-marker ability went unused this phase. No target is picked: attacks resolve on each unit within 6in of the marked point.

name: Precision
summary: Weapon ability. While allocating its attacks, if a Character model in the target unit is visible the attacker may direct them at that Character's allocation group until those attacks end or that group is destroyed.

name: Psychic
summary: Weapon ability. Its attacks may ignore any or all modifiers to the attacker's ballistic or weapon skill and to the hit roll, and they count as psychic attacks wherever another rule cares about those.

name: Psychic Assassin
summary: Weapon ability. While a Psyker unit is the chosen target, the weapon's Attacks characteristic becomes 6 until those attacks are resolved.

name: Psyker
summary: Unit-type keyword. A unit counts as a Psyker while any of its models has the keyword, an attached Leader included, and rules keyed to Psyker units - Anti-Psyker weapons among them - apply for as long as that holds.

name: Rapid Fire X
summary: Weapon ability written Rapid Fire X. Gather X extra attack dice if the target unit was within half the weapon's range at the moment targets were chosen.

name: Rapid Fire D3
summary: Rapid Fire with a rolled parameter rather than a fixed one: roll a D3 for the number of extra attack dice gathered when the target was within half range. Keyed apart from Rapid Fire X because the parameter is not a number.

name: Rapid Fire D6
summary: Rapid Fire with a rolled parameter rather than a fixed one: roll a D6 for the number of extra attack dice gathered when the target was within half range. Keyed apart from Rapid Fire X because the parameter is not a number.

name: Reverberating Summons
summary: Weapon ability. Each model it destroys lets you return one destroyed model to a friendly unit of the type the datasheet names within 12 inches of the bearer.

name: Smoke
summary: Unit keyword. It is the eligibility condition for the Smokescreen core stratagem, which for one phase gives the unit - and units it obscures - the benefit of cover against attacks.

name: Snagged
summary: Weapon ability. Each time it scores a hit on a Monster or Vehicle unit, until the end of the turn, add 2 to charge rolls the bearer makes against that unit and enemies cannot use the Fire Overwatch stratagem against the bearer.

name: Sustained Hits X
summary: Weapon ability written Sustained Hits X. A critical hit scores X further hits on the target, on top of the hit it already scored.

name: Sustained Hits D3
summary: Sustained Hits with a rolled parameter rather than a fixed one: a critical hit scores a D3 rolled number of further hits. Keyed apart from Sustained Hits X because the parameter is not a number.

name: Swarm
summary: Unit-type keyword. Swarm models move through dense terrain, get benefit of cover inside a terrain area, and are hidden in a terrain area holding dense terrain if their unit made no ranged attacks this turn or last turn.

name: Titanic
summary: Size keyword. Titanic units ignore being engaged when starting actions or when checking if they may shoot after acting, and cannot be moved through by Super-Heavy Walker units.

name: Torrent
summary: Weapon ability. Its attacks hit automatically and no hit roll is made. A torrent weapon cannot also carry Indirect Fire or Precision.

name: Towering
summary: Size keyword. A model with this keyword grants Plunging Fire, improving the attacking model's Ballistic Skill by 1, against a visible target with ground-level models within 12", without needing elevated terrain.

name: Transport
summary: Unit-type keyword. Its datasheet sets which models may embark and how many; several units can share one Transport. Units may start embarked before the battle or embark during a move, and disembark in a later Movement phase.

name: Twin-linked
summary: Weapon ability. Its wound rolls may be re-rolled.

name: Vehicle
summary: Unit-type keyword. In a normal or advance move Vehicle models move through other models except Monsters and Vehicles, and their unit may use close-quarters shooting. They cross dense terrain only where each section is 2in or less high.

name: Walker
summary: Unit-type keyword carried alongside Vehicle or Monster. A Vehicle unit may be picked for the Heroic Intervention core stratagem only if it is a Character or Walker, and a destroyed Walker that has a base is measured to from that base.
